text:
olivia: @channel Quick update: Hosted Gen API v3.1 is GA for production. New default model: redwood-mosaic-edge-1 (balanced latency/cost). We've also enabled tool-calling webhooks and a realtime toolkit for socket-based streaming. Please review rollout notes below. :tada:

jake: awesome — congrats everyone. any breaking changes?

olivia: no breaking auth changes. New features are opt-in: `stream_socket=true` and `tool_webhook=true`. We are deprecating legacy /v2 gen endpoints in 60 days; migration guide will be published today.

priya: Docs: migration guide and webhook schema are up in preview. Will add Node/Python socket examples this afternoon.

docs-bot: Preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/v3-1-webhooks (pr #459)

anya: SRE: rollout will be canary -> ramp -> full over ~5h with health checks. Added dashboards for stream.connections, webhook.err_rate, gen.latency.p95. Alerts: webhook.err_rate > 1% OR gen.p95 > 800ms -> page. Synthetic socket checks every 30s.

nina: Infra note: new instance types for edge-optimized model. Autoscaling profiles updated, cold-start warmers enabled for socket endpoints.

legal: Tool webhook privacy: customers must list external webhook domains in console and accept new terms. We'll email affected customers.

jake: example curl for quick testing (webhook mode):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v3.1/gen \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-mosaic-edge-1","tool_webhook":true,"webhook_url":"https://hooks.example.com/ai","input":"Extract action items"}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started canary for gen-pool-edge at 1832109950

olivia: Rollback: flip routing flag or route to v2 traffic-group; estimated full rollback <= 30m. Ops will watch the first 8 hours closely.

priya: Quickstarts updated for socket streaming, will push SDK helpers in next patch.

nina: Engineers needing canary keys ping me.

olivia: Thanks team. If you see any anomalies, ping #eng-oncall and tag @anya. Celebrate safely! :rocket:
